name: Cait Sith
subtitle: Veiled Terror
description: Leap from the shadows, debuffing and maim your foes before Vanishing back into the darkness.
lore: Fae spirits in feline form, cait sith are takers of souls. They stalk the recently dead, snagging spirits that have not yet moved on and dragging them away to fates unknown. Prior to the Shattering, the cait sith were content to scavenge, but now the influence of Chaos inspires some to make fresh corpses, if none are otherwise available.
divinity_generator: Gain [40] Divinity when placing a debuff on an enemy.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +5%, Armor Multiplier +2.5%, Weapon Multiplier +2.5%
